Which AUN projector is right for you?

Best under ৳8,000

A32 Pro if you want ultra-affordable big-screen movies. HD 720p is fine for casual use, and Android 13 with Wi-Fi streaming is built in. It's a dark-room projector — lights off for the best picture.

Best under ৳15,000

A45 Pro (1080p) delivers a sharper, cinema-like picture for living rooms and bedrooms — with Genuine Android TV and official apps built in. Great value for first-time buyers who want Full HD.

For bright rooms & classrooms

Honest advice first: no home projector loves direct daylight — at any price, from any brand. But our brightest models handle ambient light far better than entry models. Close the curtains where you can, and consider an ALR screen for lit rooms:

  • U002 Pro: strong in ambient light, with a dust-proof sealed engine plus more RAM/storage for smoother apps.
  • U001 Pro: our brightest projector, with genuine Android TV for Netflix/YouTube out of the box.

Android TV vs Android OS

Android TV (U001 Pro/A45 Pro) has Play Store for TV, certified casting and better app support. Standard Android (A32 Pro/A005/A005 Pro/A004 Pro/U002 Pro) is flexible and affordable; use built-in apps or plug in a Fire TV/Chromecast.

Screen size & throw distance cheatsheet

  • 80–100″ screen: plan ~2.5–3.0 m from screen (varies by model).
  • Keep projector centerline level with screen middle; use keystone sparingly for best sharpness.

Ports & connectivity

All AUN models include HDMI and 3.5mm audio. For set-top boxes/PS5/PC, use HDMI. For Bluetooth speakers, pair within device settings (on Android models).

Still deciding? Answer 5 quick questions in our 60-Second Smart Finder, put any two models side-by-side with the Compare tool, or learn how to read brightness specs in our honest guide: Projector Brightness, Explained.

Planning on your phone? The free AUN Care app shows what screen size fits your room, and previews the picture on your own wall in AR.

What is the latest projector price list in BD for 2026?

AUN projector prices in Bangladesh for 2026 start at approximately BDT 7,590 for portable HD models and can go up to BDT 32,900 or more for high-brightness, professional Full HD Android models. Prices vary based on resolution, rated brightness, smart features, and build quality.

How many lumens do I need for a room in Bangladesh?

Start from your room, not the number. Across the whole industry, spec-sheet lumens are manufacturer ratings measured at the light source, so real on-screen brightness is always lower — for every brand equally. In practice: for a dark room, any AUN home model gives a vivid picture. For a living room or classroom with ambient light, choose our brightest models (U002 Pro or U001 Pro) and close the curtains in the daytime. Full explanation in our projector brightness guide.

Is a 720p projector good enough, or should I buy 1080p?

A native 720p (HD) projector offers good quality for casual movie watching and is very budget-friendly. However, a native 1080p (Full HD) projector provides significantly sharper and more detailed images, making it the recommended choice for serious movie enthusiasts, gamers, and professional presentations with fine text or data.

What's the difference between an Android projector and a regular one?

A regular projector requires an external source like a laptop, or streaming stick (e.g., Chromecast) to display content. An Android projector has a built-in operating system (like a smart TV) that allows you to connect to Wi-Fi and install apps like YouTube, Netflix, and others directly onto the device for an all-in-one entertainment experience.

Which projector brand is best in Bangladesh?

While many brands like Epson, BenQ, and Xiaomi are available, AUN specializes in offering feature-rich smart projectors at highly competitive price points in Bangladesh. AUN focuses on providing the best value with features like native Full HD resolution and the latest Android OS, backed by an official local warranty — plus real projection photos and videos on every product page, so you can judge performance with your own eyes before buying.

Can I use a projector in a bright room?

Yes, with realistic expectations — direct sunlight washes out every home projector at every price. For a bright room, pick one of our highest-brightness models (U002 Pro or U001 Pro), control ambient light by closing curtains or blinds, and keep the image size moderate. Using an ALR (Ambient Light Rejecting) screen can also dramatically improve contrast and image quality in well-lit environments.

Do AUN projectors come with an official warranty in Bangladesh?

Absolutely. All projectors purchased from AUN Projector Bangladesh come with an official warranty and dedicated customer support. This ensures peace of mind and reliable service. Please see individual product pages for specific warranty terms and duration.

Plug In Anywhere

Meet the AUN A32 Pro — our portable pick

Best for: Portable dark-room movie nights — ৳7,590

The A32 Pro is the lightest projector we sell: HD 720p picture from 17″ up to 100″, Android 13 with built-in streaming apps, two-way Bluetooth, and a 30,000-hour LED. Turn the lights off, and any wall becomes a cinema — for less than the price of a mid-range phone.

Want sharper Full HD in a still-compact body? Step up to the A005 (1080p short-throw, great for small rooms) or the A45 Pro (1080p with Genuine Android TV).

What is the mini projector price in BD?

Are these portable projectors native 4K?

No — our portable model is native 720p (HD), which suits its palm-sized design and casual big-screen viewing. If you want sharper Full HD 1080p, see our home theater projectors starting from BDT 9,990.

How bright should a mini/portable projector be?

Honest answer: minis are dark-room projectors — turn the lights off and you get a clear, enjoyable picture; for outdoor use, wait until after sunset. Start Your Warranty

This registration page is for customers who purchased from authorized dealers, resellers, or physical shops outside our official online store. (Online-store orders are registered automatically.)

Checklist before you begin

    Frequently Asked Questions — AUN Projector Warranty

    How do I register my AUN projector warranty in Bangladesh?
    Fill in this online form with your serial number, purchase date, dealer/shop name, and an invoice photo or PDF. Our system verifies the details and activates your 12-month warranty automatically. You’ll get an SMS and email confirmation.
    How long is the AUN projector warranty?
    Every AUN projector comes with a 12-month official warranty, valid from the invoice (purchase) date. Registering ensures the start date is recorded correctly. See our full warranty policy for details.
    I bought my projector from a local shop, can I still register?
    Yes. This page is specifically for customers who purchased from dealers, resellers, or physical shops anywhere in Bangladesh. Just upload your invoice and we’ll verify it. Looking to buy a new one? Browse our official projector store.
    Where is the serial number on my projector?
    The 11–14 digit serial number is printed on a sticker on the top or side of the packaging box.
    How will I know my warranty is approved?
    If your serial and shop details match our records, approval is instant and you receive an SMS and email right away. If a manual review is needed, our team confirms within 24–48 hours.
    Can I track a projector repair?
    Yes. AUN Projector Bangladesh offers a live repair-status tracker so you can check the progress of any service request online at any time.
    Can I check my warranty in an app?
    Yes. Scan the barcode on the box with the AUN Care app and it shows whether you are still covered and exactly how many days remain. If you bought directly from us, your purchase is often linked automatically using your phone number, so there is nothing to type in.

    Frequently Asked Questions — Projector Repair

    How do I check my AUN projector repair status?
    Enter your Job Sheet number (e.g. 2025/0001) or the mobile number you gave during submission, then press “Check Repair Status.” The latest status is pulled live from our service centre.
    Can I track my repair using my mobile number?
    Yes. Choose “Mobile Number” and enter the same number you provided when you handed in your projector for service.
    How long does a projector repair take?
    Service typically takes 2–3 working days when parts are in stock. If parts must be imported, it can take 45+ days. You can follow the exact stage here at any time.
    Will I be charged for my repair?
    If your AUN projector is within its 1-year warranty and the fault is covered, the repair is free. For out-of-warranty repairs — or damage not covered by warranty — you’ll see the estimated cost up front before we proceed. See our warranty policy for what’s covered.
    My repair status is not showing — what should I do?
    Double-check your Job Sheet number or mobile number and try again after a few minutes. If it still doesn’t appear, contact our support team.
    Is my repair information secure?
    Yes. We show only limited details, data is fetched through a secure server proxy, and full information is reserved for the job owner.
    Can I track my repair on my phone?
    Yes. The free AUN Care app shows your repair moving from received, to repaired, to on its way back, with courier tracking and a notification at each stage. You can also keep using this page — both show the same live status from our service system.

    Good to know

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Quick answers to what buyers ask us most.

    Can I use it in a bright room?

    It shines in dim or dark rooms. In the daytime, just close the curtains for a vivid picture — like any home projector, full direct sunlight will wash out the image.

    What does the lumens rating actually mean?

    The brightness figure on the spec sheet is the manufacturer’s official rating, measured at the light source — the convention used across the projector industry by virtually every brand. The brightness you actually see on screen is always lower than the rated figure, for every projector on the market, because light is lost passing through the lens system. That’s why we describe every model by room type instead, and show real unedited projection photos on this page — so you judge with your own eyes, not with a number. Want the full story? Read our honest guide: Projector Brightness, Explained.

    How far should I place it for a big screen?

    Anywhere from 1.4 m to 5.7 m, giving you a 50″ to 200″ picture. As a rule of thumb, around 2.8 m gives you a 100″ cinema screen.

    Can I watch YouTube or Netflix directly?

    Yes — it runs Android 13 with preloaded apps like YouTube, Netflix and Prime Video, plus Wi-Fi screen mirroring (AirPlay & Miracast) from your phone.

    Will dust damage it in Bangladesh?

    The U002 Pro is built for Bangladesh’s dusty conditions — its optical engine is fully sealed and dust-proof, so dust cannot reach the picture-critical optics. No dust spots, no filter cleaning, maintenance-free by design.

    What about warranty and service?

    Every unit comes with a 1-year official AUN warranty. If anything goes wrong, contact our support team and send the unit to our service center — we’ll repair it and courier it back to you, anywhere in Bangladesh. You can even track your repair status live on our website. Bought from our online store? Your warranty is registered automatically. Bought from an authorized dealer or physical shop? Just register your warranty online to activate it.

    Can I pay with EMI, bKash or cash on delivery?

    Yes — we offer 0% EMI, bKash/Nagad, cards, and cash on delivery across Bangladesh.
